integrity: Proof is given as an analytic argument independent of finite numerical checks. Independent audit and mathematical validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-degree optimizing angles are described by a finite one-variable optimization, not a universal closed form; no convergence remainder or general Jacobi-weight analogue is proved. The theorem is for continuous weighted L2 projection on real BV inputs, not noisy interpolation.
title: A sharp hard-edge sine-integral law for Chebyshev projection of bounded-variation data
